jobs.description:
**About the Organization**
Now is a great time to join Redhorse Corporation. We are a solution\-driven company delivering data insights and technology solutions to customers with missions critical to U.S. national interests. We’re looking for thoughtful, skilled professionals who thrive as trusted partners building technology\-agnostic solutions and want to apply their talents supporting customers with difficult and important mission sets.  

### **About the Role**



Redhorse transforms the way government uses data and technology. To support this mission, we are seeking a Senior Software Engineer – Mission Systems Integrations to drive the development, integration, and modernization of mission\-critical tactical systems for defense and national security stakeholders.



In this role, you will be the technical integration backbone bridging tactical\-edge operations with enterprise\-scale data platforms. You will design, build, and deploy high\-performance software solutions leveraging the TAK (Tactical Assault Kit / Team Awareness Kit) ecosystem and Cursor on Target (CoT) architectures, directly enhancing real\-time situational awareness and decision advantage for operators in high\-stakes environments.



### **Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and integrate custom plugins, services, and middleware within the TAK ecosystem (ATAK, WinTAK, TAK Server, and MILTAK).
* Architect and implement Cursor on Target (CoT) data schemas, translations, and event\-routing pipelines between tactical devices and enterprise cloud systems.
* Configure, scale, deploy, and maintain TAK Server instances across diverse on\-premise, edge, and cloud operating environments.
* Build reliable, low\-latency APIs and data ingestion pipelines to ingest multi\-source sensor and intelligence feeds into tactical situational awareness interfaces.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional engineering teams, product managers, and government stakeholders to translate operational mission requirements

jobs.title: Senior Virtual Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
Worldwide, the Volkswagen Group has a long tradition of dramatic innovations. The Volkswagen Group with its headquarters in Wolfsburg, Germany is one of the world’s leading automobile manufacturers and the largest carmaker in Europe. The Group comprises twelve brands from seven European countries: Volkswagen Passenger Cars, Audi, SEAT, ŠKODA, Bentley, Bugatti, Lamborghini, Porsche, Ducati, Volkswagen Commercial Vehicles, Scania and MAN.

**Brief Role Description**
--------------------------



The Senior Virtual Cloud Engineer leads the creation and cloud deployment of a virtual Android Automotive (AAOS) infotainment ECU. The role entails designing a high\-fidelity virtual representation of the head\-unit software stack and hosting it in the cloud, enabling engineering teams across Volkswagen Group brands and regions to develop against it on demand, without the need for physical hardware. Virtualization and cloud delivery are central to the position: the engineer transforms a physical infotainment ECU into a scalable, globally accessible service and coordinates the brands, suppliers, platform providers, and partners — including the RV Tech (Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies) joint venture — required to deliver this capability.



The position forms part of the worldwide connectivity technical team and interfaces with multiple stakeholders across the Volkswagen Group technical organization. The engineer investigates and contributes to the development of new architectures for connected systems targeted to the US market.

**Role Responsibilities**
-------------------------


**Virtual ECU Architecture — Android Automotive – (35%)**


* Lead the virtualization strategy for the AAOS infotainment ECU, building configurable virtual devices on Android Cuttlefish and QEMU — together with the supporting stack of crosvm, KVM, virtio, and AVD/Android Emulator — that reproduce the production head\-unit software stack and boot sequence.
